_readme: NON-STREAM TIMEOUT: streaming requests use connect_timeout_ms (time to headers). Non-streaming requests send headers+body only at completion, so they get their own window: nonstream_timeout_ms (default 120000). Raise it if you serve long non-stream generations.
EXAMPLE CONFIG for llm-gateway v0.1 — copy to llm-gateway.json and edit.

DEEPSEEK PRICES VERIFIED 2026-08-26 against official docs: off-peak (default outside 01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays; all weekend) cache-miss rates below; peak = exactly 2x; cache-hit input near-free ($0.007 Flash / $0.022 Pro). Other providers still approximate — verify before trusting cost numbers.

PLACEHOLDER PRICING on the 'deepseek-flash' entry — VERIFY at funding time. The 'deepseek' entry carries VERIFIED (2026-08-28, api-docs.deepseek.com) deepseek-v4-flash off-peak rates: $0.22/M input cache-miss, $0.66/M output; peak is exactly 2x; cache-HIT input is ~$0.007 off-peak (gateway's 2-number pricing model ignores the cache-hit discount, so USD is conservatively OVERestimated when prompts are cached). Peak hours 01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri; all other hours off-peak.

OFF-PEAK ROUTING: a routing class may use the object form { chain, off_peak_chain }. At request time the off_peak_chain is used iff some provider IN it declares an off_peak schedule and is off-peak right now (UTC). Off-peak = outside ALL peak_utc windows; weekdays absent from every window's days are ALL-DAY off-peak — the deepseek schedule lists only Mon-Fri (days 1-5), so Sat/Sun are all-day off-peak. Window bounds are minute-resolution, start inclusive / end exclusive. Pinned provider ids (model == provider id) never consult off-peak logic.
Provider API keys are NEVER written here. Each provider names an ENV VARIABLE (api_key_env); export it before starting.

CAPABILITIES: a provider may declare an optional capabilities block { vision, tools, reasoning } (booleans; see the glm entry). Unspecified = capability NOT claimed — never overclaim: /v1/models advertises claimed capabilities with false for unclaimed, and requests carrying image parts (image_url) route only to providers that claim vision, failing with HTTP 422 when a task class has none.
Gateway keys + admin_key may be plaintext (fine for a 0600 local file) or 'sha256:<hex>' hashes via `npm run hash-key -- <secret>`.
